title: Week Summary: AI Acceleration and Hardware/Software Co-Design

concepts.name: GPU
concepts.description: A graphics processing unit used for highly parallel computation in model training and inference.

concepts.name: TPU
concepts.description: A tensor processing unit designed to accelerate tensor operations used in machine learning.

concepts.name: NPU
concepts.description: A neural processing unit designed to accelerate neural network workloads, often on edge or mobile devices.

concepts.name: Hardware accelerator
concepts.description: Specialized hardware designed to run certain computations faster or more efficiently than a general-purpose CPU.

concepts.name: Memory bandwidth
concepts.description: The rate at which data can be read from or written to memory, often a bottleneck for ML workloads.

concepts.name: Operator fusion
concepts.description: Combining multiple operations into one execution step to reduce overhead and improve performance.

concepts.name: Compiler optimization
concepts.description: Transforming code or computation graphs to run more efficiently on target hardware.

concepts.name: Hardware-software co-design
concepts.description: Designing algorithms, software, and hardware together so they fit each other’s constraints and strengths.
